jobs.title: Director of IT Communications & Engagement
jobs.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.
  
  
We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!
  
  
Summary
  
  
Provides enterprise leadership for the strategy, governance, and delivery of IT communications, organizational change management, employee engagement, user education, and service experience. This role strengthens trust in IT, accelerates adoption of technology and process change, and establishes measurable standards for clear communications, effective learning, and consistent service quality. Leads a team and influences senior and executive leaders across IT and the business to elevate the IT brand and improve the end-user experience.
  
  
Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
Set the enterprise IT experience and engagement strategy, translating technology priorities into a multi-year roadmap for communications, change adoption, education, and trust-building across IT and the business.
  
Serve as the executive communications partner to IT leadership; shape narratives, executive messaging, town halls, leader cascades, major announcements, and high-impact presentations with clear business outcomes and audience relevance.
  
Establish and govern an organizational change management practice for technology initiatives, including stakeholder analysis, change impact and readiness assessment, sponsorship, resistance management, adoption planning, reinforcement, and benefit realization.
  
Lead IT employee engagement strategy using survey insights, listening channels, recognition, leader enablement, and action planning to strengthen connection, candor, accountability, and trust within the IT organization.
  
Own the end-user education and digital adoption strategy, including role-based learning, onboarding, release readiness, self-service guidance, knowledge content, office hours, and reinforcement that help employees use technology confidently and securely.
  
Create for IT an enterprise editorial, channel, and campaign governance model across email, intranet, ServiceNow, collaboration tools, video, meetings, and other channels; define standards for accessibility, plain language, timing, approvals, and message quality.
  
Expand the service delivery framework, enhance the IT quality assurance practice and build a voice-of-the-customer program that evaluates communications, knowledge, training, case interactions, and key service journeys; identify root causes and drive measurable improvements with service owners.
  
Define and report an executive scorecard for reach, understanding, sentiment, adoption, proficiency, self-service success, service quality, and stakeholder confidence; use insights to prioritize improvements and demonstrate business value.
  
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team; set priorities, operating rhythms, quality controls, capacity plans, vendor expectations, and performance standards while fostering innovation and continuous improvement.
  
Build trusted partnerships with Corporate Communications, Human Resources, Learning and Development, Risk, Information Security, business leaders, and technology teams; advise senior leaders during transformation, service disruption, crisis, and other reputation-sensitive moments.
  
  
It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Education Requirements
  
Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, organizational development, business, technology, or a related field required. Master’s degree in business, communications, or a related discipline preferred.
  
  
Minimum Experience
  
20+ years of progressively responsible experience in strategic communications, organizational change, employee engagement, learning/adoption, brand, or related leadership disciplines, including 15+ years leading people or enterprise programs.
  
Experience advising C-suite or executive leaders and leading communications for complex technology or business transformation required. Financial services or another highly regulated industry is preferred.
  
  
Licenses & Certifications
  
No license required. Change management certification, professional communications accreditation, learning and development credentials, ITIL certification, or equivalent demonstrated expertise is preferred.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
  
  
Executive presence and judgment, with the ability to advise, challenge, and align senior stakeholders on complex or reputation-sensitive matters.
  
Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise communication, engagement, change, adoption, brand, and learning strategies that connect technology investments to employee and business outcomes.
  
Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, facilitation, presentation, and message-design skills; able to translate technical, operational, risk, and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable language.

jobs.title: Director, IT Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Overview
  
  
Performance Contracting Group is a national employee-owned specialty contractor that offers quality services and products to the commercial, industrial, and non-residential construction markets. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing employees from a diversity of backgrounds and experiences, as well as supporting a culture of safety and inclusiveness that allows you to contribute to your fullest potential. We place high value on training and professional development, encouraging you to broaden and strengthen your unique skill sets so you can fully realize your potential.
  
  
The Director, IT Engineering provides enterprise leadership for the software, data, integration, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 capabilities that enable PCG’s business operations. The role is accountable for designing, building, integrating, modernizing, and sustaining secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. This leader establishes disciplined engineering practices, clear ownership, and outcome-based roadmaps that accelerate business value while improving quality, maintainability and cost effectiveness.
  
Leadership Mandate
  
Build an integrated enterprise engineering capability with persistent ownership of custom software, business applications, enterprise data pipelines and products, APIs and integrations, and the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. Set direction, establish operating expectations, and ensure internal teams and partners are accountable for measurable business outcomes, technical quality, secure delivery, operational readiness, and sustainable lifecycle management.
  
Strategic Outcomes
  

* Faster delivery of business capabilities through modern software engineering, reusable components, automation, and clear alignment to enterprise priorities.
* Clear ownership and outcome-based roadmaps for custom software, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enterprise data products, APIs, and integrations.
* Reliable, secure, and maintainable applications supported by consistent architecture, development, testing, release, monitoring, and support practices.
* Trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise data that enables reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and better operational decisions.
* A simplified integration environment that reduces point-to-point interfaces, improves data flow, and connects Dynamics 365 with core enterprise and field systems.
* A high-performing engineering organization with strong technical leadership, talent development, financial discipline, and accountability for business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities
  

* Engineering Strategy & Operating Model: Publish and maintain a rolling 18–24-month roadmap for software, data, integration, and Dynamics 365 capabilities; review priorities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and expected business outcomes with technology and business leaders at least quarterly.
* Software Engineering: Ensure 100% of actively developed applications have an accountable owner, documented architecture, product backlog, support model, security classification, lifecycle status, and measurable service objectives. Establish automated build, test, security, and deployment controls for all material production releases.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineering: Own the platform roadmap, solution architecture, configuration, extensions, Power Platform components, security roles, integrations, data, release calendar, and partner delivery. Review customizations quarterly and require documented business justification, ownership, testing, and lifecycle plans for all approved extensions.
* Data Engineering: Assign accountable owners and service measures to all critical data products and pipelines. Monitor data quality, freshness, availability, lineage, security, and failed processing daily; maintain remediation plans for measures below target.
* Integration & API Engineering: Maintain a current inventory of production APIs, interfaces, events, owners, dependencies, service levels, and lifecycle status. Review integration health monthly and deliver an annual plan to retire redundant or unsupported point-to-point interfaces.
* Engineering Quality & Operations: Set and report monthly measures for delivery lead time, deployment frequency, failed changes, production defects, availability, incident recovery, automated test coverage, vulnerabilities, and recurring incidents. Require documented production-readiness approval before release.
* Architecture, Security & Governance Partnership: Ensure 100% of material solutions complete required architecture, security, data governance, resiliency, and operational reviews before production approval; track exceptions to an accountable owner and target resolution date.
* Talent & Culture: Maintain workforce and succession plans for critical roles, complete quarterly talent reviews, establish annual development objectives for all team members, and reduce single-person dependencies through documented cross-training and coverage plans.

Leadership Expectations
  

* Translate business priorities and operational needs into clear software, Dynamics 365, data, and integration strategies, roadmaps, investment decisions, and executable plans.
* Create clarity around solution ownership, engineering decision rights, service boundaries, data stewardship, integration responsibilities, technical standards, escalation paths, and definitions of done.
* Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, maintainability, user experience, cost, and long-term enterprise architecture.
* Engage business stakeholders early, frame operational problems before selecting solutions, and favor standard Dynamics 365 capabilities where they meet business needs before introducing customization.
* Communicate complex engineering topics in plain business language and provide transparent visibility into delivery, capacity, risk, quality, cost, technical debt, and realized value.

jobs.title: Deputy Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) is recruiting an executive leader for the role of Deputy Chief Information Officer (DCIO). The DCIO shapes the future of the Agency's digital infrastructure and information technology that enable America's return to the moon, sustaining presence in orbit around the earth, and advancement of science and discovery.
  
  
\*\* See **Additional Information** for a link to an Informational Session led by NASA's CIO, Sean Gallagher. \*\*

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Senior executives**

Individuals looking for an executive-level job and who meet the five Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs).

  

**Duties**
----------

The Deputy Chief Information Officer:

* Serves as the CIO's principal strategic partner, overseeing daily IT operations and integrating Agency IT programs to ensure capabilities, investments, and risks align with NASA's mission. Shares oversight of over $2B in IT spending and directs a blended workforce of more than 1,500 civil servants and contractors.
* Leads and coordinates across a high-impact team of executives and organizational leaders to implement NASA's integrated IT enterprise, aligning Agency-wide strategy, governance decisions, architectures, and investments to enable exploration, science, and mission support at scale.
* Ensures disciplined stewardship of NASA's IT portfolio, guiding investment lifecycle processes-including approval authority for major initiatives-to deliver secure, technically sound, financially viable solutions in collaboration with Agency financial leadership.
* Leads digital transformation and innovation, advancing emerging technologies through structured pilots, enterprise scaling, and strategic insights that empower NASA's missions in an increasingly complex technological landscape.
* Provides strategic leadership for the talent development and workforce planning of NASA's IT community, ensuring the Agency maintains the technical and leadership capabilities and capacity needed for mission-critical IT services.
* Implements enterprise performance and accountability frameworks, using data-driven metrics to assess IT effectiveness, mission alignment, service quality, risk posture, and compliance.
* Establishes enterprise processes, controls, and performance standards to ensure OCIO programs are efficient, secure, integrated, and consistently meet mission and customer requirements.
* Guides the Agency's Enterprise Architecture (EA) program enabling alignment with mission programs and customer needs and cross-domain integration while ensuring compliance with federal requirements.
* Establishes and manages enterprise customer engagement frameworks, ensuring IT services are responsive, measured through service management practices, feedback mechanisms, and continuous improvement processes.
* Integrates cybersecurity across all IT operations and investments, collaborating with the CISO to ensure enterprise-wide implementation and continuous improvement of security controls.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* The individual selected will be required to file an 'Executive Branch Personnel Financial Disclosure Report' (OGE-278e) within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on.
* Initial Senior Executive Service (SES) Career appointee is subject to a one-year probationary period.
* Successful completion of a background investigation commensurate with the risk and sensitivity level of the position.
* Successful completion of pre-employment and random drug testing may be required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance as required by the position.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen or National.
* Must meet qualifications requirements by the closing date of this announcement.
* Complete a Declaration for Federal Employment to determine your suitability for Federal employment, at the time requested by the agency.

### **Qualifications**

As a basic requirement for entry into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment, you must clearly articulate and describe within your **2-page resume** that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs) and Mandatory Technical Qualifications MTQ related to this position**.** If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and MTQ, you may be disqualified. **Any additional pages over the 2-page limit will not be reviewed.**  
  
Your resume should include evidence of progressively responsible supervisory, managerial, or professional experience which involved management of a program or organization of significant scope and complexity, normally obtained over several years by serving in positions at the GS-15 level or equivalent.
  
  
If you are (1) currently serving under a career SES appointment, (2) eligible for reinstatement into the SES (this means you were previously employed as a Career SES employee and you successfully completed a one-year probationary period), OR (3) have successfully completed a SES Candidate Development Program (CDP) and certified by OPM, you do not need to address the ECQs in your resume. However, your resume must clearly state that you are a current career SES, eligible for SES reinstatement, or SES CDP certified and year of certification.
  
  
Please **DO NOT** submit separate documents addressing the ECQs or MTQ. Only your 2-page resume will be accepted and considered. Any additional documents submitted will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Director, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance
jobs.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

**Job Title:**

Director, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:**

Prologis

**A day in the life**

The Director, IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) leads Prologis’ global IT GRC program and team, reporting to the CISO. This role establishes governance, risk, and compliance priorities across the countries where Prologis operates and partners with global business and technology teams to strengthen technology risk and control oversight. The Director works closely with Security, Infrastructure, Internal Audit, Legal, HR, Risk, Finance, and business leadership to address regulatory, audit, third-party, and information risk requirements. The role also modernizes and scales GRC processes through AI, automation, workflow improvements, and system integrations to improve efficiency, reporting, and control effectiveness.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead the global IT GRC program and establish strategy and priorities across governance, technology risk, compliance, and assurance.
* Lead IT risk and controls oversight within the Three Lines Model, including risk assessments, control requirements, risk acceptance and exceptions, control monitoring, remediation oversight, and leadership reporting aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and applicable regulatory and audit requirements.
* Oversee global technology compliance and assurance activities, including SOX, IT general controls (ITGC), GDPR, DORA, HIPAA, SWIFT, India’s Information Technology Act, and disaster recovery governance and testing oversight
* Govern third-party and cyber supply chain risk, data protection and information risk, investigations, eDiscovery, and technology and cybersecurity support for investor Operational Due Diligence (ODD) assessments and requests.
* Monitor emerging technology risks and evolving regulatory requirements, assess their impact on Prologis, translate applicable changes into GRC and control requirements, and advise leadership on implications.
* Modernize and scale GRC processes by applying AI, workflow automation, and system integrations to improve efficiency, reporting, control monitoring, and control effectiveness.
* Lead and develop the GRC team, manage GRC technology and vendors, and oversee security awareness and IT policy governance, including training campaign planning, communications coordination, and IT policy and procedure governance.

**Building blocks for success**

**Required:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in IT governance, risk, compliance, IT audit, or related disciplines.
* 3+ years of people-management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise GRC programs.
* Experience with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and the Three Lines Model.
* Experience with SOX, IT general controls, and technology-related regulatory requirements in a global environment.
* Experience applying AI, workflow automation, and system integrations to streamline GRC processes, improve reporting, strengthen control monitoring, or increase operational efficiency.
* Ability to influence executives and collaborate effectively across technology, Internal Audit, Legal, HR, Risk, Finance, and other global business functions.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive matters.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant GRC, audit, risk, or cybersecurity certification.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to evolving regulatory and technology requirements in a global environment.
* Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

**Hiring Salary Range of:**

$168,000 - $232,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target & LTI (Long Term Incentives) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

#LI-KR1

**People First**

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. **Individuals take the initiative here.**

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. **Employees advance their careers here.**

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. **People come first here.**

We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time.

jobs.title: Director of IT Architecture
jobs.description:
As the technical Director of IT Architecture, you will be responsible for leading the overall IT architecture strategy for our dynamic, growing healthcare organization. This individual will be tasked with designing systems that align with business goals, regulatory requirements, and emerging industry technologies. This role manages a talented team of IT Network, Cloud, and Systems Architects, overseeing the design, implementation, and optimization of all enterprise technology solutions. The Director works closely with IT leadership and business stakeholders to drive innovation, improve system interoperability, optimize cost and enhance security across the healthcare organization.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Strategic Leadership & Technology Roadmap:**

* Define and execute a comprehensive IT architecture strategy aligned with business, clinical, and operational goals.
* Lead and manage a team specializing in network, cloud, and systems architecture, ensuring seamless collaboration and efficiency.
* Establish and enforce IT governance, standards, and best practices to ensure compliance with industry regulations (HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, etc.).
* Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies (microservices, AI, ML) to improve healthcare delivery and operational efficiency.
* Provide strategic direction for IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Strong financial acumen, ensuring positive ROI for Architecture-led initiatives.

**Architectural Leadership & Implementation:**

* Responsible for all aspects of the Network Architecture, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performance network infrastructure to support healthcare applications and data exchange.
* Responsible for all aspects of the Cloud Architecture initiatives, including hybrid and multi-cloud strategies, ensuring compliance, cost optimization, and interoperability with on-premises systems.
* Guide Systems Architecture development, ensuring robust design, security, and integration of core business and healthcare applications, including EHR/EMR (Epic).

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Act as the primary liaison between IT architecture teams and IT leadership, translating business needs into technology strategies.
* Partner with IT Security team to develop and enforce security frameworks that protect patient data and mitigate cybersecurity threats.
* Partner with Cloud team to establish common tooling and automation (e.g., CloudFormation, AWS CDK, AWS Landing Zone Accelerator, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins).
* Work closely with software vendors, system integrators, and cloud service providers to optimize technology investments.
* Foster collaboration across cross-functional IT teams, ensuring alignment with infrastructure, security, and application teams.

**Performance Management & Risk Mitigation:**

* Establish KPIs and performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of IT architecture initiatives.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to network vulnerabilities, cloud security, and system failures.
* Optimize IT spending by implementing cost-effective solutions.
* Continuously assess system performance and scalability to meet the growing demands of healthcare operations.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT architecture, including at least 5 years in a leadership role managing network, cloud, and systems architecture teams preferably within a healthcare organization.
* Network Architecture: Strong experience with SD-WAN, VPNs, firewalls, network security protocols, and healthcare data exchange networks.
* Cloud Architecture: Strong experience with AWS, Well-Architected Framework, and hybrid cloud solutioning.
* Demonstrated history of assessing, testing, implementing modern platform visibility solutions (DataDog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus / Grafana).

**PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Master's degree preferred.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS PREFERRED:**

* Recent certifications in relevant cloud platforms (AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, etc Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, etc.).
CISSP, CCNP, HITRUST, or FinOps Certification.  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):**

* Systems Architecture: Expertise in the M365 suite, server infrastructure, virtualization, storage solutions, disaster recovery, and healthcare IT standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM, etc.).
* Security & Compliance: Knowledge of HIPAA & HITRUST compliance, and cybersecurity frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO27K). Ability to work cross-functionally with the BMCHS Information Security Team to define and design according to industry best-practice.
* Fluency in Agile, waterfall, and industry standard tooling (e.g., Jira, Project, Confluence).
* Strong leadership and team management skills. You are a thought-leader and a mentor.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. You have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You see the big picture and how it affects patient care and our bottom line.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Cybersecurity Advisory Services
jobs.description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**  
As a Senior Cybersecurity Consulting Leader with Presidio, you will be responsible for scaling an established Cyber Consulting Services organization and growing the business faster than market pace. You will lead Information Security Governance, Cybersecurity Architecture, and Offensive Security while owning the operating performance of the consulting portfolio. You will be accountable for revenue growth, gross profit and margin, utilization, delivery quality, backlog, capacity, and workforce strategy. You will lead through managers and principal consultants while maintaining technical and client credibility to challenge how the practice delivers, scales, and evolves.

**Travel Requirements:**

This is a client-facing role. You will be required to travel up to 30% to client locations to deliver professional services when needed.

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable managers responsible for consulting teams and individual contributors across multiple cybersecurity disciplines.

* Establish operating mechanisms for resource forecasting, engagement governance, project reviews, quality control, utilization management, and delivery escalations.
* Maintain executive oversight of major consulting engagements and intervene when delivery quality, project economics, client satisfaction, or contractual commitments are at risk.
* Create, evolve, and retire consulting services based on client demand, delivery performance, market changes, technical developments, and the ability to scale delivery.
* Define and improve consulting methodologies, delivery standards, costing models, level-of-effort models, and repeatable engagement structures.
* Challenge Principal-level consultants and practice leaders on technical direction, methodology, service relevance, delivery quality, and opportunities to develop new capabilities.
* Partner with Client Success Management, Sales, and pre-sales teams on strategic engagements, capacity requirements, client needs, and technical sales enablement.

* Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent work experience and/or military experience
* Minimum of 12-15 years of cybersecurity experience with progressively increasing leadership responsibility.
* Significant leadership experience in cybersecurity consulting, advisory, professional services, or a comparable client-facing security organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers as well as senior individual contributors, with experience operating geographically distributed teams of more than 20 people.
* Experience leading a multi-disciplinary cybersecurity organization that includes governance, security architecture, offensive security, or comparable consulting disciplines.
* Demonstrated financial accountability for a consulting or professional services organization, including revenue, margin, utilization, capacity, and project economics.
* Experience managing project-based consulting delivered through fixed-fee, T&M, retainer, or comparable professional services models.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales and pre-sales organizations without compromising the independence and risk-based approach of a vendor-neutral consulting practice.
* Functional understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., SOX, AICPA SOC Reporting Standards, ISO27001, PCI, NIST, HIPAA) and best practices and methodologies to address these requirements.
* Experience developing workforce plans that balance permanent employees, demand, utilization, specialized skills, and external delivery capacity.
* Experience managing subcontractors or third-party delivery resources while maintaining internal delivery capability as the primary foundation for growth.

jobs.title: Director of Technology and Computing
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located in the U.S. Department of Labor (DOL), Bureau of Labor Statistics.
  
  
All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. The Required Documents section of this announcement identifies all documents that must be uploaded in order to be considered a complete application package. Applicants that do not submit a complete application will not receive further consideration.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Senior executives**

Individuals looking for an executive-level job and who meet the five Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs).

### **Clarification from the agency**

All qualified candidates may apply. Current and/or former Senior Executive candidates must submit appropriate documentation to receive credit for non-competitive consideration.

  

**Duties**
----------

* Exercises full managerial control and oversight of the BLS IT network infrastructure, including WAN, LAN, and IT cloud environments - acquiring and securing hardware and software, and establishing usage policies.
* Oversees the BLS IT cybersecurity program, monitoring and identifying vulnerabilities, taking corrective action, and executing the IT security audit program in alignment with DOL, OMB, NIST, and other federal guidance.
* Directs the management, operation, and enhancement of BLS's internal and external websites, including the public data dissemination site and the Internet Data Collection Facility used for secure survey collection.
* Establishes and oversees contract vehicles for IT hardware, software, and professional services - identifying needs, setting technical specifications, and monitoring vendor performance.
* Reports on the BLS IT investment portfolio, ensuring timely OMB reporting of Major IT Business Cases and managing the annual IT Acquisition Authorization plan.
* Leads cross-functional teams and multi-faceted project portfolios, establishing IT project management methodologies and best practices while advising BLS executives on emerging technologies to enhance IT and statistical research capabilities.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

**Conditions of Employment**

* Must be a U.S. citizen.
* Must meet Executive Core Qualifications.
* Must complete one year SES probationary period if not previously covered.
* Complete a Declaration for Federal Employment to determine your suitability for Federal employment, at the time requested by the agency.
* Appointment to this position may require a background investigation.
* You may be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
* If selected, the candidate must receive approval from OPM's Qualifications Review Board in order to be appointed to the SES.
* If you are a male applicant born after December 31, 1959, certify that you have registered with the Selective Service System or are exempt from having to do so.
* May be subject to pre-employment and random drug tests
* File a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report OGE-278e within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on.

Candidates must possess technical and management experience and have developed the knowledge and skills required for effective performance of the specific duties of the position. Candidates must have had experience at a major management level (normally equivalent to the GS-15 level in the federal service).Applicants must meet all legal and regulatory requirements. Reference the "Required Documents" section for additional requirements.

### **Qualifications**

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution. Candidates will be hired based on merit and competence.

To meet the minimum qualification requirements for this position, you must show that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQ) and Mandatory Technical Qualifications (MTQ) related to this position within your resume - **NOT TO EXCEED 2 PAGES**. **Resumes must use a font size no smaller than 10-point, and margins no smaller than one inch. Resumes over the 2-page limit, will not be reviewed beyond page 2 or may be disqualified**. Your resume should include examples of experience, education, and accomplishments applicable to the qualification(s). jobs.title: Global Head of Technology & Infrastructure (Senior Director)
jobs.description:
**Description**

Our most important asset is our people. Who we are, what we do, how we do it and why we are passionate are all centerpieces of why we succeed.

We are proud to be recognized:

* Among America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes in 2021, 2022 and 2024
* As a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for four consecutive years (2021-2025)

*We currently operate in-office Monday-Thursday, with an optional remote day on Friday.*

***Role Summary***

As the **Global Head of Technology and Infrastructure (Senior Director)**, you will be responsible for global leadership of IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Security. The role oversees the IT organization tasks and responsibilities, which include applications, reporting, infrastructure, networks, security & compliance and end point management, along with vendor management and contract negotiations. You will define and deploy the future IT strategy and roadmap in consultation with cross functional leadership to ensure the roadmap is grounded in broad business knowledge coupled with a vision to drive efficiencies, strengthen competitiveness, achieve our strategic growth goals and maintain robust security.

This position will oversee all teams and processes to ensure efficient, effective, reliable and secure global technical operations. This role will provide direction and oversight for all major decisions impacting our technology footprint, ensuring high availability and optimal performance across all systems.

This individual will also have primary point of contact in advising executive leadership and the Audit Committee on critical topics involving technology and/or security, engaging direct IT leadership within the team to present as appropriate.

**In This Role, You Will Focus On:**

**Protecting Fellowes Business Continuity**

* Ensure that solutions meet all legal, compliance, internal controls, and accounting standards.
* Ensure information security policies, products, and procedures are keeping with industry regulations and all relevant legislation.
* Oversee security monitoring, systems health check, backup and recovery systems, and disaster recovery (DR) readiness to ensure resilience and compliance.
* Advocate and retain primary ownership of company’s information security vision. Conduct routine communication via written and in person communication with leadership and Audit Committee members on security status, threats, and remedial action.
* Oversee and manage IT business continuity and disaster recovery plan, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement
* Lead the evaluation, adoption, and governance of emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and secure integration across global business functions.

**Simplifying Operations and Reduce Cost Structures**

* Oversee IT procurement lifecycle with internal and external stakeholders. Ensure strategic sourcing mentality grounded in business efficiency, cost, and capabilities.
* Oversee integration of system and infrastructure for acquisitions and/or divestitures.

**Streamlining Systems and Automate Workflows**

* Provide leadership in planning and directing managers and directors overseeing different IT functions including Project Management, Database Admin team, systems administration, network operations, PC/desktop support, applications and reporting
* Develop/Refine the technical solutioning processes to ensure a holistic approach that considers all potential solutions across multiple departments and capabilities but derives the optimal solution.
* Act as front-line contact with others in the organization, ensuring key competencies such as full issue resolution and communications, among other things, are being addressed fully and to completion
* Verify, modify and design architectures of new and existing infrastructures for robustness, cost effective development and business growth
* Assist management in the selection, evaluation, negotiation and management of 3rd party services and vendors

**Enabling our business vision and strategy through technology solutions**

* Work with various business leaders, alongside the Director of Enterprise Applications, to develop a comprehensive technology roadmap. Includes oversight of the planning and execution of our global technology portfolio.
* Ensure alignment and cohesion between technical capabilities and/or new platforms and optimizing our technical infrastructure.
* A visionary, pro-active leadership style with exceptional detail orientation and a drive to exceed expectations

**What You Bring to the Team**

* Bachelor’s Degree in information technology, Computer Science or related field. A Master’s degree in technology or business is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years related experience comprised of both management experience and hands-on technical experience in most of the following services and technologies:
  + WAN/LAN networks (Cisco)
  + Storage/SAN (Pure)
  + Remote connectivity (Citrix/Xen)
  + Microsoft Technologies (E.g.: AD, Azure, Office 365, Teams)
  + Disaster recovery
  + Private and Public Cloud technologies
  + Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, CIS Controls etc.)
* 5+ years of process mapping, selection, implementation and support of technologies that deliver business solutions and enhanced capabilities
* Extensive experience leading IT delivery teams inclusive of scope, scheduling, budgeting and project planning
* Experience with distributed operations. Can understand the complexities and considerations of integrating a successful data driven connected enterprise.

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview
  
  
Performance Contracting Group is a national employee-owned specialty contractor that offers quality services and products to the commercial, industrial, and non-residential construction markets. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing employees from a diversity of backgrounds and experiences, as well as supporting a culture of safety and inclusiveness that allows you to contribute to your fullest potential. We place high value on training and professional development, encouraging you to broaden and strengthen your unique skill sets so you can fully realize your potential.
  
  
The Director, IT Engineering provides enterprise leadership for the software, data, integration, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 capabilities that enable PCG’s business operations. The role is accountable for designing, building, integrating, modernizing, and sustaining secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. This leader establishes disciplined engineering practices, clear ownership, and outcome-based roadmaps that accelerate business value while improving quality, maintainability and cost effectiveness.

* Trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise data that enables reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and better operational decisions.

* Engineering Strategy & Operating Model: Publish and maintain a rolling 18–24-month roadmap for software, data, integration, and Dynamics 365 capabilities; review priorities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and expected business outcomes with technology and business leaders at least quarterly.
* Software Engineering: Ensure 100% of actively developed applications have an accountable owner, documented architecture, product backlog, support model, security classification, lifecycle status, and measurable service objectives. * Engineering Quality & Operations: Set and report monthly measures for delivery lead time, deployment frequency, failed changes, production defects, availability, incident recovery, automated test coverage, vulnerabilities, and recurring incidents. Require documented production-readiness approval before release.
* Architecture, Security & Governance Partnership: Ensure 100% of material solutions complete required architecture, security, data governance, resiliency, and operational reviews before production approval; track exceptions to an accountable owner and target resolution date.
* Talent & Culture: Maintain workforce and succession plans for critical roles, complete quarterly talent reviews, establish annual development objectives for all team members, and reduce single-person dependencies through documented cross-training and coverage plans.

Leadership Expectations
  

* Translate business priorities and operational needs into clear software, Dynamics 365, data, and integration strategies, roadmaps, investment decisions, and executable plans.
* Create clarity around solution ownership, engineering decision rights, service boundaries, data stewardship, integration responsibilities, technical standards, escalation paths, and definitions of done.
* Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, maintainability, user experience, cost, and long-term enterprise architecture.
* Engage business stakeholders early, frame operational problems before selecting solutions, and favor standard Dynamics 365 capabilities where they meet business needs before introducing customization.
* Communicate complex engineering topics in plain business language and provide transparent visibility into delivery, capacity, risk, quality, cost, technical debt, and realized value.

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Consulting Leader with Presidio, you will be responsible for scaling an established Cyber Consulting Services organization and growing the business faster than market pace. You will lead Information Security Governance, Cybersecurity Architecture, and Offensive Security while owning the operating performance of the consulting portfolio. You will be accountable for revenue growth, gross profit and margin, utilization, delivery quality, backlog, capacity, and workforce strategy. * Establish operating mechanisms for resource forecasting, engagement governance, project reviews, quality control, utilization management, and delivery escalations.

* Create, evolve, and retire consulting services based on client demand, delivery performance, market changes, technical developments, and the ability to scale delivery.
* Define and improve consulting methodologies, delivery standards, costing models, level-of-effort models, and repeatable engagement structures.
* Challenge Principal-level consultants and practice leaders on technical direction, methodology, service relevance, delivery quality, and opportunities to develop new capabilities.
* Partner with Client Success Management, Sales, and pre-sales teams on strategic engagements, capacity requirements, client needs, and technical sales enablement.
* Develop technical enablement that helps Sales and pre-sales teams identify, position, and qualify appropriate cybersecurity consulting opportunities.
* Engage CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and other executives during strategic engagements, client escalations, executive briefings, and consulting sponsorship activities.

* Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent work experience and/or military experience
* Minimum of 12-15 years of cybersecurity experience with progressively increasing leadership responsibility.
* Significant leadership experience in cybersecurity consulting, advisory, professional services, or a comparable client-facing security organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers as well as senior individual contributors, with experience operating geographically distributed teams of more than 20 people.
* Experience leading a multi-disciplinary cybersecurity organization that includes governance, security architecture, offensive security, or comparable consulting disciplines.
* Demonstrated financial accountability for a consulting or professional services organization, including revenue, margin, utilization, capacity, and project economics.
* Experience managing project-based consulting delivered through fixed-fee, T&M, retainer, or comparable professional services models.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales and pre-sales organizations without compromising the independence and risk-based approach of a vendor-neutral consulting practice.

* Experience developing workforce plans that balance permanent employees, demand, utilization, specialized skills, and external delivery capacity.
* Experience managing subcontractors or third-party delivery resources while maintaining internal delivery capability as the primary foundation for growth.
